title: cbdMD, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: cbdMD, Inc. filed a Form 8-K disclosing director compensation arrangements, including the grant of 1,572 RSUs to each independent director and the approval of annual cash retainers for board members.
key_points: The board granted 1,572 RSUs to each independent director and the non-management employee director as compensation for services starting March 31, 2026.
RSUs vest quarterly over four quarters ending March 31, 2027.
Annual cash retainer of $35,000 for each independent director, payable monthly.
Additional fees: $26,500 for Board Chairman, $17,000 for Audit Committee Chairman, $7,000 for Compensation Committee Chairman.
Audit Committee members receive $8,500 additional; Compensation Committee members receive $4,000 additional.
The company is listed on NYSE American under ticker YCBD.
